items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had remembered his name of being on a Dizzy Gillespie record with a, people uh, names like Kansas Fields

ctx.x: Yeah, very, very brief, yeah. Uh, I just went over to the table and uh, uh, you know, I had remembered his name of being on a Dizzy Gillespie record with a, people uh, names like Kansas Fields [laughs] and then John Coltrane. I started being suspicious, were these stage names or what? But they ended up to be real. But uh, I got friendly, I bonded with uh, Richie Powell, you know, the young brother of uh, Bud. And we stayed up almost all night. It was already late.[laughs] But after, he was able to uh, impart some…
What was gas a gallon, do you know?
